# FIGlet catalog notice

The distributed catalog is owned by the optional `SharpVision.FigletFonts`
package. Its packaged `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` identifies the 18 official FIGlet
fonts under BSD-3-Clause and `Classy` under MIT, with exact source commits. Full
license texts ship in the package's `licenses/` directory, and every embedded
FIGfont retains its original comment notice.

No font from the former `xero/figlet-fonts` snapshot remains in `SharpVision` or
`SharpVision.FigletFonts`.
